rules.description: Zed: Fn/Control+Space opens code completions via Hyper+J
Zed: Cmd+Shift+Tab rejects and regenerates the Copilot prediction
Zed: preserve physical Command/Option on Enter
Global: Cmd+Enter behaves like Shift+Enter outside Zed
Zed: Fn+Option+Up/Down adds cursors
Zed: Fn+Shift+Arrow keys move lines
Zed: Cmd+Q expands and Cmd+Shift+Q contracts syntax selection
Disable Command+Q quit shortcut
Disable Command+Shift+Q logout shortcut
Zed: Control+Arrow keys for subword navigation
Zed: preserve Command+Arrow line navigation
Zed: Fn+Arrow keys for subword navigation
Command+Shift+Space toggles input source (English <-> Arabic), replacing Fn/Control+Space
Option+Tab opens Mission Control via Control+Up; Command+Tab remains for AltTab
Mission Control fallback for Fn+Option+Left/Right
Ctrl/Fn+Z performs Undo
Terminal/nano: Ctrl/Fn navigation and exit
Option shortcuts: new app instances, Terminal window, and Finder window
Ctrl/Fn+V paste only
Terminal: Ctrl/Fn+Backspace deletes previous word reliably
Spotlight, AltTab reservation, and yabai maximize/minimize
Clipboard policy: Ctrl/Fn only; Option+V opens Maccy
Terminal: Ctrl/Fn+Shift+C copies
Mission Control mode cleanup on Escape or Enter
yabai Windows-style window and Space shortcuts
Windows/Linux modifier layout: Fn+Control=Ctrl, Option=Win, Command=Alt
Disable the dedicated Spotlight (magnifying glass) key so it does nothing
Windows extras: Ctrl/Fn+L, Win+D, Alt+Delete, and Terminal hotkey
Terminal: Ctrl/Fn terminal editing
Terminal: Fn+C sends Ctrl+C (interrupt command)
Ctrl+K => Cmd+K (Chrome - Create Link)
Ctrl++ => Cmd++ (Chrome - Zoom In)
Ctrl+- => Cmd+- (Chrome - Zoom Out)
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+X => Cmd+C (Copy), Cmd+V (Paste), Cmd+X (Cut)
Ctrl+Z => Cmd+Z (Undo)
Ctrl+Y => Cmd+Shift+Y (Redo)
Ctrl+A => Cmd+A (Select all)
Ctrl+S => Cmd+S (Save)
Ctrl+N => Cmd+N (New)
Ctrl+F => Cmd+F (Find)
Ctrl+H => Cmd+Option+F (Find and Replace - Only in Code)
Ctrl+H => Cmd+Y (History - Only in Chrome)
Ctrl+J => Cmd+Option+L (Open Downloads - Only in Code)
Ctrl+W => Cmd+W (Close)
Home => Cmd+Left arrow (Move cursor to beginning of line)
Shift+Home => Cmd+Shift+Left arrow (Move cursor to beginning of line with selection)
Ctrl+Home, Ctrl+Shift+Home => Cmd+Up arrow, Cmd+Shift+Up arrow (Move cursor to beginning of file with and without selection)
End => Cmd+Right arrow (Move cursor to end of line)
Shift+End => Cmd+Shift+Right arrow (Move cursor to end of line with selection)
Ctrl+End, Ctrl+Shift+End => Cmd+down arrow, Cmd+Shift+down arrow (Move cursor to end of file with and without selection)
Helium: Fn+Shift+T reopens the last closed tab

to.shell_command: /usr/bin/osascript -e 'tell application "Helium" to activate' -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Helium" to click menu item "Reopen Closed Tab" of menu "File" of menu bar 1'
/usr/bin/osascript -e 'tell application "Helium" to activate' -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Helium" to click menu item "Reopen Closed Tab" of menu "File" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Helium: Fn(Control)+F5 and Fn(Control)+Shift+R perform a hard reload
Ctrl+T => Cmd+T (New tab)
Ctrl+B => Cmd+B (Bold)
Ctrl+I => Cmd+I (Italic)
Ctrl+L => Cmd+L (Open url location) (Only in browsers)
Ctrl+R => Cmd+R (Reload) (Only in browsers)
F5 => Cmd+r (Reload)
Ctrl+(Shift)+Right/left arrow => Alt+(Shift)+Right/left arrow (Move cursor one word with selection and without selection)
Ctrl+Backspace/Delete => Option+(Fn)+Delete (Remove a whole word ahead or behind)
Ctrl+Up/down arrow => Up/down arrow (Move cursor up/down)
Ctrl+Shift+Esc => Open Activity Monitor
Return => Cmd+o (Open) (Only in Finder)
Finder rename mode: F2 starts (Return), Return/Escape end it
Delete => Cmd+backspace (Delete) (Only in Finder)
Backspace => Cmd+up (Go back) (Only in Finder)
Ctrl+Left Click => Cmd+Left Click (select multiple items)
Print Screen => Cmd+Shift+9 (Lightshot Screen Capture)
Ctrl + Arrow Keys to Option + Arrow Keys
Ctrl + Shift + Arrow Keys to Option + Shift + Arrow Keys
Ctrl + BS/Del Keys to Option + BS/Del Keys
